Title: Display a login form
Preconditions: 1. The user is logged out. 2. The Home page is open in Chrome.
Steps: 1. Click Signup / Login in the header.
Expected Result: The system displays a login form with Email Address and Password fields and a Login button.

Title: Login with a valid email and password
Preconditions: 1. A registered account exists with name "Lara QA", email "lara.qa.tc01@mailinator.com", and password "Test1234". 2. The user is logged out. 3. The Home page is open in Chrome.
Steps: 1. Click Signup / Login in the header. 2. Enter the email in the Email Address field. 3. Enter the password in the Password field. 4. Click Login.
Expected Result: The Home page is displayed and the header shows "Logged in as Lara QA".

Title: Logout button displayed after login
Preconditions: 1. The user is logged in with the account "Lara QA" (lara.qa.tc01@mailinator.com / Test1234). 2. The Home page is open in Chrome.
Expected Result: The header shows a Logout button.

Title: Logout returns the user to the login form

Expected Result: 1. The login form ("Login to your account") is displayed. 2. The header no longer shows "Logged in as Lara QA".
